quarterly_data.quarter: Sanyo Denki results briefing Q&A: FY 2025 Results Briefing Q&A Summary (05-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on San Ace fan demand: demand related to GPU servers and AI will continue to grow, and the company is proactively advancing product development for large fans, so it expects operating revenue to continue rising steadily. Asked about chiller-free cooling technology presented at NVIDIA's conference, management does not expect any impact at this point: GPU servers inevitably generate heat, so cooling remains essential. For AI servers the biggest issue in servers and data centers is power consumption, so its top priority is fans that combine low power consumption with high airflow and high static pressure; both aerodynamic and motor performance must improve, with no major change in its basic approach.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanyo Denki results briefing Q&A: FY 2025 Results Briefing Q&A Summary (05-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A) on the FY2026 forecast (company numbering; FY 2025 ended March 2026): the San Ace Company margin is forecast lower because component prices are rising with market conditions and, depending on timing, price pass-through may not fully absorb the increases. The Electronics Company margin is forecast higher mainly on increased operating revenue - the company expects stronger semiconductor-related demand for SANMOTION, and the business has a high marginal profit ratio; there it is working to reduce procurement costs and pass higher costs on through selling prices. The Motion Company margin fell in 4Q FY2025 because material costs have risen since the second half of FY2025 and backlog orders plus negotiation time delay pass-through; its FY2026 forecast incorporates price revisions, a shift to higher-margin new products and increased demand, and price revisions will continue as needed.
